capabilities: Fall back between public and local URLs
extras: Fixes the HTTP 410 Gone error seen in unmaintained Memos plugins; supports Memos 26.x+ (/api/memos) and legacy /api/v1/memos; installable via BRAT or by manually copying main.js and manifest.json. README is bilingual (Chinese/English).
motivation: Built to support the latest Memos REST API (/api/memos) where /api/v1 has been removed, while keeping legacy /api/v1/memos compatibility.
problem: Self-hosted Memos entries stay outside the vault, and older sync plugins fail with HTTP 410 Gone on newer Memos releases.

relations.evidence: syncs your self-hosted Memos into Obsidian

summary: Sync plugin that pulls self-hosted Memos into Obsidian, downloading attachments and updating marked daily-note blocks without overwriting manual edits.
